description: Do not ask for a GitHub PAT in chat. Use an owner-authorized private credential channel, or omit the PAT and use manual provider setup. These legacy schema fields document the underlying operation, not permission to send secrets through MCP. Stop auto-deploying from git. Always clears the Impreza-side webhook state (further pushes are rejected — the token/signature no longer matches). For a GitHub one-click hook, supply `github_pat` to also DELETE the webhook from the repo cleanly; for a manual/generic hook (GitLab, Bitbucket, Gitea, self-hosted, CI) remove it yourself in your provider's webhook settings. Idempotent — calling on an already-disconnected deployment is a no-op success.

github_pat.description: Optional. Supply to also remove the webhook on GitHub.

name: impreza_git_webhook_disconnect
title: Disconnect git auto-deploy
